# Bálint Décsi

> Personal portfolio and CV of Bálint Décsi — Data & ML Engineer, CTO at Proximata, and Builder at mesh. Covers work experience, client projects, certifications, open-source code, and small tools.

The site is a single scrollable page; each section also has its own URL.

## Pages

- [/](/): One-pager — biography, at a glance, skills, work, experience, certifications, and code.
- [/work](/work): Featured work — Proximata, the ingatlan.com MSc capstone, client engagements at Deutsche Telekom and Vodafone Hungary, plus tools and demos.
- [/experience](/experience): Employment history and education, with a downloadable full CV (PDF).
- [/certifications](/certifications): Certifications, badges, awards, and scholarships with verification links.
- [/code](/code): Side projects, theses, and open-source repositories grouped by category.
- [/featured/msc-thesis](/featured/msc-thesis): Full report of the Budapest rental price prediction capstone for ingatlan.com.
- [/tools/ceu-feedback/index.html](/tools/ceu-feedback/index.html): CEU FeedForward — anonymous student feedback platform demo.
- [/tools/pdf-to-word/index.html](/tools/pdf-to-word/index.html): PDF to Word converter, fully client-side.
- [/tools/unibridge/index.html](/tools/unibridge/index.html): Unibridge — onboarding companion for international students.
